hypothesis: Can a trainable multiplicative binding of factual fifth-action key, observed fifth physical effect and candidate return-action key learn the intervention-conditioned choice WITHOUT hard-coded public action-match indicators, and transfer to held-out synthetic altered cubic dynamics?

factual_training.source: unaltered R33 factual 3072 selected return episodes, 1152 pair-train and 384 pair-heldout; only 576 publicly identifiable informative FIT pairs optimized, 192 informative heldout
factual_training.train_info_selector: selected fifth action==public context, derived solely from P80 factual action keys; no generator hidden sign

architectures.learned_bind: each input is raw P80 16D fifth-action key, 16D selected fifth-effect, 16D return key; separate trainable Linear16->16 + tanh embeddings; elementwise triple product of 16 latent dimensions then trainable MLP64->64->1 combined with additive latent embeddings; no Boolean match/context, no learned generator hidden q labels
architectures.additive: same three Linear16->16 projections and 64D head but replace factorized triple-product channels by simple additive embedding (matched parameters, same input); tests need for interaction, nonlinear head can still indirectly interact
architectures.raw: unchanged R35 ProbeValueMLP as negative/control, trained informative-only
architectures.engineered: R37 PublicGateMLP with FIT-only physically selected noninformative fifth offset; human-coded joint match × observed effect, must remain explicitly labeled engineered positive reference
architectures.native_plus_binding: existing R34 native FactualMemory with its trainable recurrent/history readout plus learned factorized binding head; report binding-only, substrate-only and native-backbone-zeroed action ablations
architectures.gru_ssm_plus_binding: same binding addition to existing R34 GRU/SSM history readout; one seed only; not matched model compute or capacity
architectures.erased: same binder but fifth selected effect zeroed during training and scoring
architectures.shuffled: same binder, deterministic R37 context-preserving deranged selected fifth-effect donor (synthetic inconsistent negative control only)

training.optimizer: AdamW lr=.002 for standalone, raw and engineered; lr=.001 for native/GRU/SSM with binding; weight_decay=.01, clip_norm=1
training.loss: binary paired categorical cross-entropy on two independently selected actual factual FIT return costs; lowest cost action label; no auxiliary simulator targets

synthetic_cubic_transfer.law: baseline .25*s-.08+.05*sin(3*s), plus 2.7*q*(s^3-.15^3) only when return or probe action==public context; this law not used by FIT, no external source
